children: Bristol Myers Squibb reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $13.07B, up 6.9% from $12.22B a year earlier. Net income was $2.16B, down 1.5%, while diluted EPS fell 2.8% to $1.05.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net earnings/(loss)”. ³ Reported as “Earnings/(Loss) per common share”.
Growth Portfolio sales increased 12% in the quarter, with gains in Breyanzi, Camzyos, Reblozyl and Opdualag; Opdivo sales declined.
U.S. Eliquis sales rose 39% after a list-price reduction lowered rebates. Generic competition weighed on Revlimid and Pomalyst.
Zenbexus was approved, and mezigdomide’s new drug application was accepted. Phase III studies for admilparant and RYZ101 reported positive results.
Bristol Myers Squibb plans manufacturing campuses in Texas and Indiana and expects its productivity initiative to generate about $2B in annual savings by the end of 2027.
